evidence_boundary: Current-base device owner record with current Android debug APK installed on Nubia P0110/pacific. It captures safe USB waiting and ADB-reverse-missing observations plus blocked state boundaries; it intentionally cannot close the README Phase 1 actionable-errors gate.
notes: This manifest is the current-base owner record for the requested Phase 1 actionable-error states.
It intentionally keeps the README gate open until every state has retained real-device evidence and per-state user-visible recovery copy.
The raw Android ADB serial is used only in commands during collection and is redacted from public artifacts.

repository.name: TaoSama/vibe-screen
notes: Started from a clean detached HEAD equal to origin/main before creating the evidence branch.
Android debug APK was rebuilt from the working tree after the automatic USB guidance fix and installed on the P0110 device before the final ADB-reverse-missing observation.
The retained evidence is public-safe and redacts the raw ADB serial.

artifacts.description: Nubia P0110/pacific Android 16 identity with public ADB serial redacted.
Current-base precondition showing a local TCP 54321 listener was present.

blockers: A local Vibe Screen process was already listening on TCP 54321 during the current-base run, so the missing-listener state could not be reproduced without interrupting a shared Host process.
closure_requirements: Retained Host-not-listening or port-conflict evidence paired with the exact Android user-facing error UI
Proof that bounded retry does not become a successful stream without a listener
A closing run must be collected on current source after the Host/UI surface under test is selected
notes: The 2026-08-24 record retains historical missing-listener logs, but this 2026-08-27 current-base run does not relabel them as current-source acceptance.
states.owner: Android USB connection guidance and Host listener readiness evidence

artifacts.description: ADB reverse --list output after removing tcp:54321 for the current-source observation.
Post-fix UI dump from the ADB-reverse-missing observation; it shows visible USB waiting/checklist state, not the route-unavailable recovery copy.
Bounded logcat window for the ADB-reverse-missing observation. This run did not retain app-tagged recovery lines.
ADB reverse --list output after restoring tcp:54321 following the observation.

blockers: The current-source device run removed tcp:54321 reverse and restored it afterwards, but the retained UI still showed the generic USB waiting/checklist surface rather than the ADB route unavailable recovery copy.
closure_requirements: Controlled run that removes or omits tcp:54321 reverse mapping under a held device lease
Retained before/after adb reverse --list output and Android user-facing recovery surface
Proof that the Host recreates the reverse rule or presents a concrete manual recovery action
notes: The code fix keeps retryable SessionProtocolException failures eligible for inline guidance during automatic USB retry.
The retained post-fix device UI shows the app remains visible and not stuck on a blank video-only surface, but it is still not enough to close this state.
states.owner: Android USB transport and Host ADB reverse recovery evidence
